en.name: Dialga
en.description: A Pokémon from before time began. It is said that time started moving when Dialga was born.

attacks.name: Roar of Time
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.

fr.name: Dialga
fr.description: Un Pokémon légendaire sur lequel se fonde la naissance du temps.

attacks.name: Hurle-Temps
attacks.effect: Défaussez la première carte du dessus du deck de votre adversaire.

es.name: Dialga
es.description: Un Pokémon legendario del que se dice que dio comienzo al tiempo.

attacks.name: Distorsión
attacks.effect: Descarta la primera carta de la baraja de tu rival.

it.name: Dialga
it.description: Un Pokémon leggendario di cui si dice che abbia dato inizio al tempo.

attacks.name: Fragortempo
attacks.effect: Scarta la prima carta del mazzo dell'avversario.

de.name: Dialga
de.description: Ein Pokémon, von dem man sagt, dass es die Zeit auf den Weg gebracht hat.

attacks.name: Zeitenlärm
attacks.effect: Lege die oberste Karte vom Deck deines Gegners ab.

pt-br.name: Dialga
pt-br.description: Um Pokémon lendário do qual se diz que deu início ao tempo.

attacks.name: Rugido do Tempo
attacks.effect: Descarte a carta de cima do baralho do seu oponente.

zh-tw.name: 帝牙盧卡
zh-tw.description: 傳說中會操縱時間的寶可夢。

attacks.name: 時光咆哮
attacks.effect: 將對手的牌庫上方1張卡丟棄。
